The institutional investor held 60,450 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $5.54M, up from 5,550 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jacobs Levy Equity Management Inc who had been investing in Lincoln Electric Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.05 billion market cap company.
